description: Write or remove one row of an app table by hand (support, a fix): action "save" with { owner, data } for a new row of that user, or { id, data } to replace an existing row; action "remove" with { id }. Users never see other users’ rows; this is the developer side.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

group.description: Or a group (neblla_group): the new row is the group's

owner.description: The user id in the app (for a new row)

name: neblla_table_row
title: Table row
